name: Amo View
privacyPolicy:
Effective Date: 20 June 2026

1. Who We Are

Amo View is a global streaming, learning, and creator-monetisation platform. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over it. It applies to the Amo View mobile apps and any related services we offer.

2. Information We Collect

We collect only what we need to run the service:

  • Account & profile: name, username, email, phone number, profile picture, gender, date of birth, country, preferred currency, and an optional bio.
  • Authentication: if you sign up with a password, we store it as a one-way salted hash — never in plain text. If you use a third-party sign-in provider (e.g. Google, Apple), we only receive the basic profile fields you authorise.
  • Identity verification (KYC): when you request your first withdrawal of earnings, we collect a legal name, a government-issued ID image, and a selfie. These are reviewed only by our internal moderation team and are used for document authenticity, face match, and sanctions screening. They are not shared externally except where compelled by law. Creating an account, publishing free or paid content, and earning do not require KYC — only cashing out does.
  • Verified payout phone numbers: for creators, we store up to three phone numbers you have proven you control via OTP. Withdrawals can only target a number in this list when the platform's AML lock is on (the default).
  • Content you upload: the videos, audio, books, livestreams, playlists, and short episodic series you publish, plus the titles, descriptions, thumbnails, categories, and pricing you attach to them.
  • Activity: watch history, likes, comments, subscriptions, saves, search queries, viewing-time records (used for creator earnings and analytics), and the devices you sign in from.
  • Wallet & transactions: wallet balance, top-ups, payouts, withdrawals, purchases, and a ledger of every credit and debit. We never see your full payment-instrument details — they stay with the regulated payment provider you choose.
  • Messaging: chat threads, messages, and media you share through in-app messaging and broadcast channels.
  • Device & technical data: device model, operating-system version, app version, a device identifier, IP address, push-notification token, and crash / error logs.
  • Live media: when you join or host a live session, audio and video are relayed only for the duration of that session and are not recorded by us unless you explicitly choose to.

3. How We Use Your Data

  • To create your account, sign you in, and keep the service running.
  • To deliver the content you ask for and pay creators the share they have earned.
  • To process payments, top-ups, and withdrawals through licensed payment partners.
  • To meet our payment partners' AML obligations — screening for sanctioned or politically-exposed individuals, monitoring for layering and structuring patterns, and locking withdrawals to phone numbers you have verified via OTP.
  • To send notifications you have opted in to (new content from people you follow, messages, live invitations, payout updates).
  • To detect abuse, fraud, copyright infringement, and content that violates our Acceptable Use Policy and Community Guidelines.
  • To comply with applicable law and respond to lawful requests from authorities.

4. Categories of Third Parties We Share Data With

We do not sell your personal data. We share only what is necessary to provide the service, and only with vetted processors bound by contract:

  • Cloud hosting and content-delivery providers — to host and stream your uploads to viewers.
  • Push-notification and crash-reporting providers — to deliver alerts and diagnose issues.
  • Real-time media providers — to power live audio / video sessions and calls.
  • Mobile-money payment processors (PawaPay): PawaPay processes deposits, withdrawals, and creator payouts on our behalf across our supported markets. We share the minimum required: the transaction amount, currency, your mobile-money phone number, the provider (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, etc.), and a unique transaction identifier.
  • Identity-verification providers: when you apply for a verified creator badge or want to withdraw funds, your ID document and selfie are processed by document-authenticity and face-match services bound by data-protection contract.
  • OTP / SMS providers (Twilio Verify): used to verify your account phone and any payout phone numbers you add.
  • Google Gemini — powers our in-app AI features (such as summarisation and content Q&A). Only the content you submit to the AI feature is sent; never your account credentials.
  • Authorities — when we are legally compelled to disclose (for example, a valid court order or AML investigation).

You can request the current list of named sub-processors by emailing info.amoview@gmail.com.

5. How We Protect Your Data

  • All traffic between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+).
  • Authentication tokens are stored in the device's secure enclave; passwords are one-way hashed.
  • Internal admin actions are role-gated and recorded in an audit trail. Every disable of the payout-number AML lock is captured with the operator's identity, time, and reason.
  • Paid content is served via short-lived, viewer-locked signed URLs.
  • KYC documents (ID image, selfie) are stored encrypted at rest in a private bucket with restricted access via signed URLs; they are never indexed by search.

6. Data Retention

We keep account-level data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we permanently remove your profile, channel, and push tokens within 24 hours. Records we are legally required to keep — such as financial ledgers for tax and audit purposes, and KYC records for the AML retention period required by national law — are retained for the period required by law and are detached from your personal identity wherever possible.

7. Your Rights

  • Access & edit: view and edit your profile from Settings > Edit profile.
  • Export: request a copy of your data by emailing info.amoview@gmail.com.
  • Block / unblock: manage blocked users in Settings > Privacy & Security.
  • Revoke devices: sign out other devices from Privacy & Security > Manage devices.
  • Clear watch history: available in Privacy & Security.
  • Manage payout numbers: add, view, or remove your verified payout phone numbers in Privacy & Security > Payout numbers (up to 3, each verified via OTP).
  • Delete your account: use the in-app option in Settings > Privacy & Security, or this Account Deletion page — no password required, works for all sign-in methods.
  • Object, correct, or restrict processing in line with applicable data-protection law. Contact us using the address below.

8. International Transfers

Amo View is a global service. Your data may be processed in countries other than the one you live in. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards (such as standard contractual clauses) to protect transfers across borders.

9. Children

Amo View is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age required by your country, if higher). If we discover an account belongs to a child under that age, we will delete it. To monetise content or withdraw funds, you must be 18 years old or older.

10. Contact

Questions about this policy, or to exercise any of the rights above? Email info.amoview@gmail.com.

11. Changes

If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify you in the app and update the date at the top of this page.
terms:
Last Updated: 20 June 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms

By creating an Amo View account or using the Amo View apps, you agree to these Terms, to our Privacy Policy, and to our Acceptable Use Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age required by your country if it is higher, to create an account. To monetise content or use creator features (publishing paid videos, audio, ebooks, paid live sessions, paid 1:1 services), you must be 18 years old or older. To withdraw funds or unlock a verified creator badge, you must additionally complete identity verification (KYC) at the time of your first withdrawal.

3. Your Account

  • You are responsible for keeping your sign-in credentials confidential and for any activity that happens under your account.
  • Notify us immediately at info.amoview@gmail.com if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.
  • One person, one account. Accounts may not be shared or sold.

4. Content You Upload

  • You retain ownership of the content you upload. You grant Amo View a worldwide, royalty-free licence to host, stream, encode, and distribute that content within Amo View, only as needed to operate the service.
  • You must have all necessary rights to the content you upload. Content that violates our Acceptable Use Policy — including copyright infringement, hate speech, sexual exploitation of minors, glorification of violence, fraud, and the other categories listed there — will be removed.
  • We use automated tools and human moderators to review content. We may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these Terms, with or without notice.

5. Wallet, Payments, and Monetization

  • Top-ups and withdrawals are processed through licensed payment partners. The available payment methods, supported currencies, and any fees are shown to you at checkout.
  • Creators earn a share of net revenue from paid views, unlocks, gifts, and bookings. The exact split for any product is shown to you before publishing.
  • Withdrawals are subject to identity verification (KYC), minimum-balance thresholds, and an AML lock that limits payouts to phone numbers you have verified ownership of via OTP (up to three numbers per creator). The lock can be temporarily disabled by Amo View administrators for documented exception cases; every such disable is logged in our audit trail.
  • Disputed transactions: contact info.amoview@gmail.com within 14 days of the transaction.

5a. Paid Direct Messages

  • Who can enable paid DMs: both Creators and normal accounts can charge for direct messages from Settings > Privacy & Security > Paid Messages. Enabling paid DMs on a normal account does not grant Creator Workspace tools — those remain exclusive to Creator accounts.
  • Payment modes: the DM owner chooses either Pay before messaging (the sender pays before their first message is delivered) or First message free (the DM owner may require payment to continue after an initial free message).
  • Wallet-first payment: paid DMs are charged to your Amo View Wallet, the same wallet used for Shopping. If your wallet balance is insufficient, you will be prompted to top up via our existing PawaPay-backed top-up flow before the message can be sent.
  • Payment is held, not released immediately: when you pay for a DM, the amount is held until the DM owner replies. The DM owner only receives the funds once they respond to your message.
  • Seven-day maximum: a paid DM interaction is capped at 7 days from payment. If the DM owner never replies within that window, the full amount is automatically refunded to your wallet.
  • Finishing early — "I'm Done": if you feel the paid interaction is complete before the 7-day window ends, you can press I'm Done to release the held payment to the DM owner immediately.
  • Claims for non-participation: if the DM owner replies once and then stops participating, a Claim refund action becomes available starting 24 hours after their last message. Filing a claim is evaluated against actual conversation activity, not granted automatically — the platform favours the DM owner where the evidence shows they genuinely participated.
  • Refund calculation: where a claim is upheld, you may receive up to 60% of your original payment back. The platform's 10% fee on the transaction is never part of the refundable amount. The original payment, the platform fee, the amount released to the DM owner, and any refund are each recorded separately in our ledger.
  • Platform fee: direct payments — including paid DMs, content purchases, Ebooks, Stories, Live sessions, meetings, and gifts — carry a 10% platform fee. This is separate from Shop's 5% commission and from pay-as-you-go streaming rates.
  • Enforcement: repeated failure to respond, excessive delay, or failure to participate in paid DMs is tracked internally and may result in restrictions on a DM owner's ability to accept paid messages.
  • Acknowledgement required: you must read and accept these paid-DM terms via the checkbox shown at the time of payment before any paid DM transaction can be completed.

6. Prohibited Conduct

  • No scraping, reverse-engineering, or automated abuse of the service.
  • No bypassing paywalls, watermarks, or other protection mechanisms.
  • No re-uploading other creators' content without permission.
  • No spam, phishing, harassment, or other behaviour that targets or harms other users.
  • No withdrawing to a phone number you don't control, no opening multiple accounts to layer wallet activity, and no use of the service to launder funds or evade sanctions. Suspected AML violations are reported to law-enforcement and the relevant payment partner.

7. Live Streaming & Messaging

You are responsible for what you say and show in live sessions, broadcast channels, and direct messages. Live content can be reported and reviewed by our moderation team. Severe violations result in immediate account suspension.

8. Service Availability

We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We may add, modify, or discontinue features at any time. We will give reasonable notice for changes that materially affect creators' ability to earn.

9. Termination & Account Deletion

You may delete your account at any time from Settings > Privacy & Security > Delete account, or via the Account Deletion page on this Trust Center. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms; in those cases, unpaid creator earnings tied to disputed activity may be withheld pending review, and where required by law, made available to the relevant authority.

10. Disclaimer & Liability

The service is provided "as is." To the maximum extent allowed by applicable law, Amo View is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

11. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Amo View is incorporated, without regard to its conflict-of-law provisions. Nothing in these Terms affects mandatory consumer-protection rights that local law grants you and that cannot be contracted out of.

12. Contact

Questions about these Terms? Email info.amoview@gmail.com.

Privacy Policy for ADM Ministry

Effective Date: 01 March 2026

1. Introduction

ADM Ministry Platform is dedicated to protecting the privacy of our members, staff, and leadership. This policy outlines how we collect, store, and secure your personal and spiritual data.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information necessary to facilitate church operations and communication:

  • Identification: Full name, gender, marital status, and baptism records.
  • Contact: Phone numbers and email addresses for ministry alerts and OTP verification.
  • Ministry Data: Assigned branches, departments (e.g., Choir, Ushers), and leadership roles.
  • Financial Records: Tracking of tithes, offerings, and pledges for ministry accounting.

3. Data Usage & Security

Your data is used strictly for internal ministry purposes, such as attendance tracking and financial reporting. We implement the following security measures:

  • Encryption: All passwords and sensitive tokens are cryptographically secured.
  • Access Control: Data is only visible to authorized personnel like Pastors and Treasurers.
  • Infrastructure: We use secure hosting and trusted SMS gateways for all communications.

4. Your Rights & Account Deletion

You have the right to review your data or request its removal. To permanently erase your profile and deactivate your account, please use the Account Deletion tool found in the app settings or on this compliance hub. Once authenticated, your personally identifiable information will be removed from our active databases.

5. Contact Information

For questions regarding your data, please contact your local Branch Administrator or the Ministry Head Office.

name: G-Cards
privacyPolicy:
G-Cards — Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 14 July 2026

1. Who We Are

G-Cards is a Tanzania-based digital invitation and guest-management platform, operated at www.gcards.co.tz. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over it. It applies to the G-Cards web app, the guest self-service pages, and the gate-scanner PWA.

2. Who Uses G-Cards

  • Event owners — the person (or business) that creates an event on G-Cards to send digital invitations.
  • Collaborators — helpers an event owner invites to assist with the guest list, card artwork, or gate scanning.
  • Guests — people who receive an invitation via WhatsApp or SMS and land on a personal G-Cards invitation page.

The data we collect and how we use it depends on which of these three roles is interacting with the service.

3. Information We Collect

3.1 From event owners and collaborators

  • Account & profile: full name, phone number (used as the primary login), optional email, chosen password (stored one-way hashed, never in plain text), business or event name, and role (owner, collaborator, scanner, super admin).
  • Event data: event name, date, venue name and coordinates, host text, couple / celebrant names, dress code, program schedule, and event branding you upload.
  • Financial records: a per-event billing record and manual payment receipts recorded by G-Cards staff. We do not store card numbers — payments happen outside the platform (mobile money, bank transfer, cash).

3.2 From guests you invite

  • Contact: first name, optional last name, phone number, and optional separate WhatsApp number.
  • Invitation state: the guest type (single / double / family), RSVP status (yes / no / maybe / pending), meal preference and dietary flags if you collect them, VIP status, tags you assign (e.g. Family, Church, Work), and any pledge amount or item you record.
  • Delivery history: which channel (WhatsApp or SMS) each message went through, whether it was delivered / read, and any RSVP button reply the guest tapped.
  • Attendance: the timestamp of each scan at the venue gate and who scanned them.
  • WhatsApp availability: a cached flag showing whether the guest's number is registered on WhatsApp — refreshed at most once every 30 days.

3.3 From all users of the web app

  • Device & technical data: browser type, IP address, and short-lived session tokens used to sign you in.
  • Audit logs: a record of sensitive actions (payment status changes, account deletions, role changes) with actor, timestamp, and the target of the action.

4. How We Use Your Data

  • To create your account, sign you in, and keep the service running.
  • To generate personalised QR codes and self-service invitation pages for each guest.
  • To send invitations, reminders, and post-event thank-you messages through WhatsApp (via the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API) and SMS (via Beem Africa).
  • To validate guests at the venue gate when a scanner scans their QR code.
  • To provide event analytics (RSVP rate, arrival rate, delivery rate, message cost) to the event owner.
  • To bill the event owner manually and unlock message sending once payment is confirmed.
  • To detect abuse, fraud, or bulk unsolicited messaging that would violate WhatsApp / Beem terms.
  • To comply with applicable Tanzanian law and respond to lawful requests from authorities.

5. Categories of Third Parties We Share Data With

We do not sell your personal data. We share only what is necessary to provide the service:

  • Meta Platforms (WhatsApp Cloud API) — we send the guest's phone number and message body so Meta can deliver the invitation. Meta's own privacy policy governs how they handle that data.
  • Beem Africa — we send the guest's phone number and message body so Beem can deliver the SMS.
  • Cloud infrastructure providers — the server that hosts G-Cards (Linode) stores all data at rest.
  • Payment providers — G-Cards uses manual payment. We do not automate any payment; the event owner pays G-Cards directly through mobile money, bank transfer, or cash, and G-Cards staff record the payment.
  • Authorities — when we are legally compelled to disclose (for example, a valid court order).

6. How We Protect Your Data

  • All traffic between your browser and our servers is encrypted in transit (HTTPS).
  • Passwords are one-way hashed with bcrypt.
  • All access to guest data is role-gated: scanners can only see the guests of events they were invited to, collaborators can only see the events they were added to, and only super admins can view cross-tenant data.
  • QR codes carry short-lived, signed tokens; card artwork and QR images are served through signed URLs that expire.
  • Post-event artwork (QR images, card templates, Excel imports) is automatically purged from disk seven days after the event date. The guest records themselves are retained so files can be regenerated on demand.
  • Sensitive actions (payment toggles, hard deletes, role changes) are recorded in an audit trail.

7. Data Retention

Account records for event owners and collaborators are retained while the account is active. Guest records tied to an event are retained until the event owner deletes the event, or the event is archived and later removed by G-Cards staff. When you delete your account, we permanently remove your profile, tenant, and any events you own within 24 hours. Records we are legally required to keep — such as basic financial ledgers for tax purposes — are retained for the period required by Tanzanian tax law and are detached from personally identifying details wherever possible.

8. Your Rights

  • Access & edit: event owners and collaborators can view and edit their profile inside the G-Cards web app.
  • Guest requests: if you are a guest who received an invitation and you want your data removed from a specific event, contact the event owner first; they can remove you directly. If you cannot reach the event owner, email us at support@gcards.co.tz.
  • Delete your account: use the Account Deletion page on this Trust Center. No password is required — deletion is authorised via the phone number on the account.
  • Export a copy of your data: email support@gcards.co.tz and we will return a machine-readable export within 30 days.
  • Object, correct, or restrict processing: in line with applicable data-protection law, contact us using the address below.

9. International Transfers

G-Cards is operated from Tanzania, but WhatsApp Cloud API and Beem may process data outside Tanzania to deliver messages. Where required, we rely on the safeguards provided by those processors' own contractual terms.

10. Children

G-Cards is intended for adults planning weddings, kitchen parties, send-offs, graduations, and similar events. It is not directed at children under 13. If we discover an account belongs to a child under that age, we will delete it.

11. Contact

Questions about this policy, or to exercise any of the rights above? Email support@gcards.co.tz.

12. Changes

If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify active event owners by WhatsApp or email and update the date at the top of this page.
terms:
G-Cards — Terms of Service

Last Updated: 14 July 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms

By creating a G-Cards account or using the G-Cards website, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old to create an event owner account and to send invitations on behalf of others. Collaborators and scanners may be at least 16 years old, at the invitation of an event owner.

3. Your Account

  • You are responsible for keeping your phone number and password confidential and for any activity that happens under your account.
  • Notify us immediately at support@gcards.co.tz if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.
  • One person, one owner account. Owner accounts may not be shared or sold. Collaborator and scanner roles are per-event and non-transferable.

4. Guest Data and Consent

  • You may only upload phone numbers and details of guests you have a legitimate reason to invite (family, friends, colleagues, or contacts explicitly given to you for an event).
  • You confirm you have permission from those guests to send them an invitation via WhatsApp or SMS.
  • You will not use G-Cards for cold outreach, mass unsolicited marketing, political mobilisation, or any content that violates the terms of our messaging partners (Meta / WhatsApp, Beem Africa).
  • You will honour guest opt-outs — if a guest replies asking to stop, do not re-send.

5. Card Artwork and Content

  • You retain ownership of the card artwork, host text, and photos you upload. You grant G-Cards a limited licence to store, resize, and deliver that content to the guests you invite through the service.
  • You confirm you have all necessary rights to the content you upload and will not upload material that infringes copyright, contains hate speech, or violates Tanzanian law.
  • We may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these Terms, with or without notice.

6. Payments

  • G-Cards uses manual payment. There is no automated card or mobile-money gateway on the platform. You pay G-Cards directly through mobile money, bank transfer, or cash, and G-Cards staff mark your event as paid once payment is confirmed.
  • Message sending (WhatsApp, SMS) is disabled until your event is marked paid. All other features — creating the event, adding guests, generating QR codes, uploading card artwork — are available on the free tier before payment.
  • Pricing tiers and add-ons are published at gcards.co.tz/pricing. Prices are quoted in Tanzanian shillings (TZS) and include applicable local taxes where required.
  • Refunds: because event campaigns are time-bound and message deliveries incur real cost to G-Cards, we do not offer refunds once messages have started sending. Contact support@gcards.co.tz if you believe an error was made.

7. Messaging Costs and Provider Terms

G-Cards sends WhatsApp messages using the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and SMS through Beem Africa. Your use of the messaging feature is additionally subject to those providers' policies. G-Cards is not responsible for message-delivery outages caused by those providers, but we will make reasonable efforts to notify you and resend when appropriate.

8. Prohibited Conduct

  • No scraping, reverse-engineering, or automated abuse of the service.
  • No bypassing the payment gate to send messages before your event is marked paid.
  • No uploading guest lists you obtained without consent (leaked databases, purchased lists, etc.).
  • No harassment, phishing, or use of the platform to send content that violates Meta or Beem terms.

9. Service Availability

We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Post-event artwork (QR images, card artwork, Excel imports) is automatically purged seven days after the event date; if you need to regenerate a QR after that window, use the in-app regenerate button.

10. Termination & Account Deletion

You may delete your account at any time using the Account Deletion page on this Trust Center. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms; in those cases, unused prepaid balance may be forfeited if the violation involved fraud, abuse, or messaging-partner policy violations.

11. Disclaimer & Liability

The service is provided "as is." To the maximum extent allowed by applicable Tanzanian law, G-Cards is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service — including but not limited to the failure of a message to deliver, a mis-scan at the venue gate, or downtime.

12. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Republic of Tanzania. Disputes will be resolved in the courts of Dar es Salaam.

13. Contact

Questions about these Terms? Email support@gcards.co.tz.
